brief: I need an assistant that answers HR policy questions for shore staff. It should cover leave policies (annual, sick, maternity, emergency), travel and reimbursement procedures (per diems, hotel limits, expense submission), and the company code of conduct. It must refuse questions about vessel operations, cargo, or any topic not in the HR policy documents. The audience is shore-based employees who need quick, accurate policy answers without having to read the full manual.
scope: The assistant will answer shore-based employee questions regarding HR policies, leave, travel procedures, and the code of conduct based on provided documents. It will strictly refuse questions concerning vessel operations, cargo, or out-of-scope topics.
audience: Shore-based employees of Acme Corp seeking quick and accurate policy answers.
must_answer_topics: Travel booking procedures and raising a travel request
must_refuse_topics: Any topics not contained in the provided HR policy and travel documents
groundability_issues: The documents cover annual leave and travel procedures, but lack explicit details for sick leave, maternity leave, emergency leave, and the company code of conduct mentioned in the brief.
